components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Tactile primary action in carbon black ink with 14px radius.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 44px; padding: 0 22px; border: none; border-radius: 14px; background: #131316; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: Lexend, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, transform 0.1s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #35353C; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #131316; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 44px; padding: 0 22px; border: 1px solid #E4E4E7; border-radius: 14px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #0A0A0B; font-family: Lexend, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #F4F4F5; border-color: #D4D4D8; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #131316; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Selection chip group demonstrating solid ink inversion.
components.css: .ds-chip-group { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 15px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Lexend, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid #F0F0F2; background: #FFFFFF; color: #52525B; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #E4E4E7; color: #0A0A0B; } .ds-chip-active { background: #0A0A0B; color: #FFFFFF; border-color: #0A0A0B; } .ds-chip-active:hover { background: #131316; color: #FFFFFF; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Clean data entry field with 10px radius and black hairline focus ring.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Search people, notes, prayers" />
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #E4E4E7; border-radius: 10px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #0A0A0B; font-family: Lexend, sans-serif; font-size: 14.5px; box-sizing: border-box; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #0A0A0B; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(10, 10, 11, 0.08); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #A1A1AA; }

components.name: Summary Stat Card
components.description: Restful slate card with heavy display number and zero drop shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #F4F4F5; border-radius: 24px; padding: 26px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-card-stat { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 38px; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.03em; color: #0A0A0B; } .ds-card-label { font-family: Lexend, sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; color: #52525B; }

components.description: Floating nav rail with pill-shaped inversion for active destination.

narrative.overview:
CISA Campus Work Tracker is built on the Ink design system: a calm, high-clarity monochrome shell paired with purposeful stage chroma and warm tactile surfaces suited for on-campus collegiate ministry. Unlike generic SaaS administration portals that spray decorative purple gradients, celebratory confettis, and gamified badges across every screen, Ink creates a quiet, focused canvas where real human beings, scripture passages, and field encounters provide the only color.

The visual architecture is anchored in fill-contrast rather than bordered containment. Crisp white pages hold soft slate cards, tactile rounded controls, and dense typography calibrated for split-second readability under bright campus sunlight. Black ink serves as the primary action and accent signal; when an element calls for attention, its emphasis is unmistakable because saturation has been deliberately reserved.
keyCharacteristics: Near-Monochrome Shell: Pure white page canvas, soft zinc/slate cards, and carbon black actions.
Reserved Chroma: Saturated hue is strictly reserved for contact stages on The Journey, urgency signals, and people marks.
Fill-Over-Border Contrast: Cards and surfaces separate by tonal lightness steps rather than wireframe hairline borders.
Vocal Typography: Heavy Plus Jakarta Sans display headlines providing immediate directional leadership, supported by studious Lexend body text and literary Literata scripture.
Tactile Monotonic Hierarchy: A strict descending radius ladder ensures nested elements nest comfortably without visual distortion or stadium-clamped controls.

rules.name: The Inversion Rule
rules.body: Selection and activation are expressed as solid ink inversion (solid black background with white text), never as a faint 6% tint. When an item is selected, it turns inside out.

rules.name: The Reserved Chroma Rule
rules.body: Color belongs exclusively to people, spiritual journey stages, and urgent status signals (success green, warning amber, danger red). The chrome, navigation, cards, and buttons remain strictly monochrome.

rules.name: The Accent Rarity Rule
rules.body: Interactive text signals and primary black buttons occupy less than 10% of any viewport. Rarity is what guarantees their command of attention.

rules.name: The Scripture Exclusivity Rule
rules.body: The serif typeface (Literata) is strictly reserved for biblical passages and key study verses in the Bible study reader. It is never used for general app titles, cards, or navigation chrome.

rules.name: The Vocal Headline Rule
rules.body: Headings must lead with heavy weights (700 or 800) and visible size contrast. A page where headings sit at the same weight as body copy fails the Ink standard.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Content cards, list rows, and sub-panels carry zero box-shadow at rest. Depth is established purely by background tone and 1px soft hairline boundaries where needed.

rules.name: The Single Floating Slab Rule
rules.body: In desktop rail mode, the navigation rail is the only persistent elevated floating slab on screen. Multiple floating islands competing for elevation are prohibited.

rules.name: The Monotonic Radius Rule
rules.body: Nested elements must strictly descend in corner radius: Shell (32px) → Card (24px) → Panel (14px) → Control (10px). A child element must never have a larger corner radius than its parent container.

rules.name: The No-Stadium-Input Rule
rules.body: Form inputs, textareas, and search fields shorter than 60px height must never use rounded-xl or rounded-full. They must strictly use rounded-sm (10px) to prevent unsightly stadium/lozenge clamping.

dos: Do separate cards from the page using tonal background fill (#F4F4F5 on #FFFFFF), not drop shadows or heavy borders.
Do invert selected items to solid black fills with white text (The Inversion Rule).
Do enforce the descending radius ladder: Shell 32px → Card 24px → Panel 14px → Input 10px (The Monotonic Radius Rule).
Do reserve Literata serif strictly for scripture readings and key study verses (The Scripture Exclusivity Rule).
Do use heavy Plus Jakarta Sans weights (700 or 800) for major headers to ensure strong scanability.
Do ensure interactive links and clickable names use --accent with persistent underlines (underline underline-offset-2).
donts: Don't use faint low-alpha tints (e.g. 6% black) for active selection states — they become invisible.
Don't use rounded-xl or rounded-full on inputs, search bars, or textareas under 60px height.
Don't add decorative box-shadows to cards or content tiles.
Don't introduce colored focus rings (blue, purple) to form controls; use the black hairline focus ring.
Don't use Literata serif for general UI buttons, navigation items, or system dashboards.
Don't introduce hardcoded hex colors or arbitrary Tailwind palette classes (bg-blue-500, text-indigo-600); always read from the semantic design tokens.
